item.skt: ts+tshan+da rat+nA ka ra nA ma
item.coloph: rtsod pa'i dus kyis thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /'di ni chos ldan ra sa ba dang / yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o/ slad kyi sa gsum na 'gren zla dang bral ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te byang chub rtse mo'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba las/ slar yang de nyid kyi bka' yis rjes su gnang ba la brten te/ bla ma de nyid dang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gyis legs par bskyangs pa'i dge slong nam mkha' bzang pos/ shAkya'i dge slong sdom brtson dam pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan sde snod gsum gyi glegs bam gcig pu/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i phyag bris kyi rgya dpe la gtugs nas/ dpal e'i chos grwa chen por bsgyur cing zhus te dag par bgyis so

item.tib: sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas stag tshang lo ts+tsha bas bsgyur ba
item.skt: ts+tshan+da rat+na a ka ra nA ma
item.coloph: rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdebs sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ 'di rang 'grel dang bcas pa la chos ldan ras pa dang / yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / lo chen byang rtse ba rnams kyis sum rim du bsgyur ba'i mthar/ lo tsA ba nam mkha' bzang pos dag par bsgyur ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi dper brjod ston pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa/ sdebs sbyor so so'i rkang pa'i yig grangs su byas 'dug pas/ bod skad la shin tu mi bde ba gcig byung zhing / bod skad la sdeb sbyor zhig pas lci yang sogs kyi rim pa mi dgos pa bzhin du/ yig grangs kyang mi dgos/ mdo'i dper brjod ston pa rgya skad kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ bod la go bde zhing bzung sla bar/ stag tshang pa shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur ba'o
